unresolvedConflicts.subject: Undisclosed North American minority co-investments
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Mirova may hold minority co-investments in North American renewable assets that are not publicly disclosed at the platform or company level, particularly through club deals or co-invest structures.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Review underlying MET fund investor reports, LP disclosures, or regulatory filings to identify any undisclosed North American minority co-investments.

unresolvedConflicts.issue: Mirova Energy Transition (MET) funds may deploy capital via special purpose vehicles (SPVs) that are not branded or disclosed as standalone portfolio companies, obscuring potential North American exposure.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Inspect MET fund-level reports, asset lists, and transaction disclosures to determine whether any SPVs correspond to North American infrastructure equity holdings.

unresolvedConflicts.subject: Project-versus-platform disclosure risk
